info.name: HRVMS Mobile - Dummy Pages APIs (P1+P2+P3)
info.description:
All 12 feature areas from the mobile dummy-pages audit: Announcements, Emergency SOS, Resignation/Exit Interview (P1); empLT, Onboarding sub-screens, Exit Pass, Grievance (P2); Chat FAQ, Clinic Manager (P3). Existing endpoints are included alongside new ones per request — routes tagged [EXISTING] were already live before this batch, [ALIAS] are new route names pointing at existing controller methods (zero new business logic, just the URL shape the mobile audit expected), [NEW] are newly implemented.

All base64-looking path params ({id}/{sos_id}/{announcementId}/{assign_id}/{pass_id}) are base64-encoded (matches existing convention across this API, e.g. base64_encode(61)).

NOT included (confirmed no backend work needed, per the audit doc's own findings):
- Grievance Informal Resolution: no new endpoint - the existing grievance/grievance-store already has a required grievance_informally field; the mobile dialog is UI-only and either ends there (Yes) or proceeds to grievance-store with grievance_informally=No (No).
- Chat Group / Chat Boat / HR Chat: separate chat backend (chat_repository.dart, not thewisdom.io/api) per the audit doc's own note - out of scope for this API.
- Bot Settings / Groq Chatbot Dialog: local settings / external Groq API, no HRVMS backend involved.
- Clinic Manager - Medical History Details: route already matches exactly (clinic/medical-history-details/{emp_id}) - mobile-side wiring only.
- HOD Exit Pass Dashboard: route already matches exactly (boarding/boarding-hod-dashboard) - mobile-side wiring only.
- Onboarding Assigned Staff Dashboard: route already matches exactly (on-boarding/assigned-staff-dashboard) - mobile-side wiring only.
- empLT Training Calendar/Details: routes already match exactly (learning/employee-training-calendar, learning/training-details/{id}) - mobile-side wiring only.
- The ~13 UI-shell pages (Login wrapper, Request Listing, View All variants, tab containers, QR scanner widget, etc.) - confirmed navigation/receive-via-router-extra only, no API needed, per the audit doc's own list.

query.description: Must match the manifest's transportation_mode string exactly (Seaplane, Speedboat, Domestic Flight, International Flight)

request.description: Apply Leave / Departure Pass screen: Departure Time and Arrival Time should NOT be freely editable - they must come from the manifest HR/Admin already scheduled (boarding/manifest-store). Call this after the employee picks transport mode + date, populate the time field(s) from the response, and disable manual entry. Returns an array since multiple manifests can exist for the same mode+date (e.g. two seaplane flights) - if more than one comes back, let the employee pick which one. No existing endpoint filtered by mode+date before this (manifestListing only filters by arrival/departure type, no mode/date).

urlencoded.description: Required field - already covers the 'resolved informally?' question, no separate endpoint needed

request.description: No new endpoint built for 'grievance/informal-resolution' - grievance_informally is already a required field on this existing store endpoint. The mobile dialog is UI-only: 'Yes' (resolved informally) ends the flow client-side with no API call, 'No' proceeds to this same endpoint with grievance_informally=No.
New faqs table, per-resort. Chat Group / Chat Boat / HR Chat screens are NOT included here - separate chat backend per the audit doc's own note.
